description: Send Claude Code session data to AgentGuard. The hook hands the work to a detached background process and returns at once. The command is valid in both sh (macOS, Linux, WSL, Git Bash) and PowerShell (Windows without Git Bash): see NOTES.md.

hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null
sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/agentguard.sh"; exit 0
#> > $null; try { & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path (Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts') 'agentguard.ps1')))) } catch { }; exit 0
